snippet.title: The Elder Scrolls Online - Tales of Tamriel | Xbox Games Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
Discover your next big adventure in The Elder Scrolls Online. Explore a diverse fantasy world, experience rich stories and unforgettable characters, and forge your own path in the legendary setting of the Elder Scrolls—you belong here!

The Elder Scrolls Online is available on Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One. Purchase the 2025 Content Pass for access to the game and the all-new Seasons of the Worm Cult adventure. Purchase the 2025 Premium Edition for access to the game, the all-new Seasons of the Worm Cult story, and ALL previous ESO adventures. We’ll see you in Tamriel!   

Discover the endless adventures you can unlock with Xbox Series X|S. Shop Now: https://www.xbox.com/consoles
